compareVerdict: ROUND 2 (Fable's named defects fixed against a fresh plate measurement; log: 3d/sea/passes/passlog.md). W1 THE WATER: the moonpath is now the plate's own measured envelope (6 px row scan at L>95) - narrow at the moon end (3.2 m half-width), a 4-5 m plateau amidships, DEAD by Z +7 instead of round 1's flat 15 m-wide law with a 17 m stray zone running to Z +26; soft pow(0.6) flanks, coherent 1.9 m shard gaps, luminance capped at 1 (the blown-core multiplier is gone), sub-facet twinkle from three incommensurate world-space waves, and a base lift re-read as running upstage (-Z) so the off-path water carries gentle swell instead of confetti. Band width now 40 px median / 111 px max against the plate's 62 / 131, with 589 pixels above L 235 against the plate's 1438 - under the plate rather than over it. W4 CLIFF MATERIAL: twoToneFacets() grades every facet on two axes - the moon's lambert (cool #7c7d7f..#818387) and each practical's lambert x range (warm #563a37 -> #976e5d -> #c47935) - with the plate's own near-due-west low key and gamma 2.3, so the east faces fall to its near-black navy (#0c0e13 against the plate's #11141e) and no half-turned face can reach mid-gray; the recess wash was moved downstage of the face it lights (upstage practicals have negative lambert and painted nothing), the buttress carries the plate's pale rock pair, the brow boulders drop out of being the palest thing in frame. MINOR: the moon's halo is now two additive billboards (15.5-unit bloom + 42-unit tail) matched to the plate's measured sky profile (L 70 at the rim, 47 at r 196 px, reaching ~250 px) instead of one 10.5-unit sprite that was smaller than the glow it was meant to carry. Honest residuals: the plate's hand-cut shards are larger and more considered than the 1.9 m facet grid, and its band still carries more blown white than ours; its ledge silhouettes stay crisper.
